notes.title: v21b Update
notes.notes:
Updates
- Client and server maintenance, and infrastructure updates.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed incorrect earned exp in some instances.

notes.title: v21a Update
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed a case where the fishing daily quest cannot be completed.
- Fixed a case where the game resolution changes unexpectedly upon opening the settings menu.
- Fixed 'Record as of' not updating correctly.
- Fixed a bug related to battle audio.
- Fixed a bug where it is impossible to select two of the EA characters.

notes.title: v21 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36028442/66807cc0eb6a88634903a6c50ca2c2f8edec0e26.png
Features
- Added quest Nighthawk Way.
- Added enemy ???.
- Added ability to update the fitness tracker in the settings menu.
- Added four exclusive early access characters.

- Added new items: Iron Armor+1 and Blue Candy.
- A winter storm has appeared on the horizon.
- Added achievements:I'm Stepping OutUp on the Sun
Changes
- Music tracks have been added, removed, and updated.
- Statistics in the journal have been unified for all players.
- Updated the loading screen.
- Updated battle panel.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed various minor graphical issues.

Misc
- Characters below are exclusive for those who play WREN during early access.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36028442/d79440e49cc0c67b07d99f7142d86a27814da3d7.png

- WREN will be leaving early access in January.  

Thank you for the support during this journey,
Jon

notes.title: v20a Update
notes.notes:
Changes
- Improved user experience if the server is taking awhile to respond. 
- Updated Mana Well eruption.  

Bug Fixes
- Fixed Halloween quest not immediately updating on completion. 
- Fixed a case where starting a quest results in the game hanging.

notes.title: v17a Update
notes.notes:
Features
- WREN has been optimized to support ultrawide monitors.  

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where updating character name or greeting incorrectly changes the character sprite.
- Fixed a case where the current resolution setting is not accurate.

notes.title: v17 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36028442/298ff42aca2293e24000c8240f81ec6e8ce6d2d6.png
Features
- The season has changed in WREN.
- Added spooky decorations and music starting in mid October through Halloween.
- Added quest to help the ghost near Halloween.  
- Added achievement:
 I Put A Spell On You
Changes
- Removed the confirmation window when crafting weapons and consumables.
- Friends and other players who have not played in awhile no longer appear in town.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed step activities reversed in other player's journal.
- Fisher can no longer be pushed.
- Fixed minor graphical issues.

notes.title: v16 Update
notes.notes:

Features

- Added enemy Wyrm.
- Added Farm, Fish, Livestock, and Strange Tree Level 4.

- Added achievements: Songbird

 Harvest Moon
 Raspberry Beret
 John the Fisherman
 Lament For The Aurochs
 Head Over Heels

notes.title: v15 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36028442/eaf031d075d2198249232da5084a5942429f2e58.png
Features
- Fitbit is now supported.

Count your steps with a Fitbit® Watch or mobile app.

- It's Summer and the world has a new look.
- Added new leaderboard for Steps.
- Added four achievements: 3030
 Don't Dream It's Over
 Ramble On
 Stepping Razor
Changes
- Increased Mana gained from Walking or Hiking.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed scene clipping with some screen aspect ratios.
- Fixed incorrect layer for the strange tree.

Misc 
- WREN is now 25% off during the Steam Summer Sale!
- Stay healthy and safe out there.

notes.title: v14 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36028442/1d27678a98b8293f697f6f92d5ffcb054a3f315d.png

Features
- Added quest West Loop.
- Added enemy Ogre.
- Added Blacksmith Level 2.
- Added new Weapons (Imbued).
- Added new Armor (Leather).
- Added ten new character appearance options.
- Added two world music tracks.
- Added three achievements: Sowing The Seeds Of Love
 Knives Out
 Piece of Pie
Updates
- Updated Pixie battle background.
- Updated cloth armor and crude weapon sprites.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed Mana counter updating incorrectly when a quest is partially completed.
- Fixed music sometimes cutting out during battles.
- Fixed some achievements not activating on Steam.
- Fixed building tiles updating late during upgrade.
- Fixed a case where activities are not logged correctly.
- Other minor fixes.

Misc 
- In light of recent world events, WREN will remain in Early Access until 2021.
